! Game text
| Deploy on table. If Hidden Base on table: Once per game, may exchange Hidden Base indicator with a system under your Starting Effect, and once per turn, may deploy a system from under your Starting Effect. {{Errata hl|1=If Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers on table: Once per turn, you may disregard game text which prevents a Force drain from being cancelled.}} ({{Errata hl|1=Immune to Boring Conversation Anyway and Alter.}}) || Deploy on table. If Hidden Base on table: once per turn, may deploy a system from under your Starting Effect; and, once per game, may exchange Hidden Base indicator with a system {{Errata hl|1=(from parsec 1 to 8)}} under your Starting Effect. {{Errata hl|1=May not be canceled.}} (Immune to Alter.)
